meta.pricing_note: Every price and cap rate below is illustrative. The per-unit price is a round number chosen to sit inside the band a real per-unit sale price occupies; it is not a quote, an offer, or a broker's guidance.

summary.address_provenance: Street address read from the synthetic marketing package; city/state/ZIP confirmed against the same document.
summary.product_detail: 180 units across six plans: 62 one-bedroom (720–795 SF), 78 two-bedroom (1,050–1,140 SF), 26 three-bedroom flats (1,380 SF), 14 three-bedroom townhomes (1,620 SF). Washer/dryer in unit; detached garages on 24 units.
summary.tax_rate_evidence: Rate as billed, 2.148 per $100 of assessed value, read from the synthetic county bill for the 2025 tax year.
summary.tax_basis_note: Synthetic basis. On a real deal this row states what the basis IS in that state and whether it resets on sale.
summary.notes: Synthetic deal built to exercise the output formats. Pricing is illustrative and no licensed data source was used. Comps come only from an operator's own weekly rent scrape.

comps.coverage_note: Synthetic coverage statement. On a real deal this is measured from the operator's own scrape by tools/comp_coverage_probe.py, using the scraper's own status taxonomy rather than an assumed one.

transfer_tax.caveat: The bar is on enacting a transfer tax after 2016-01-01; Texas had none, so the rate is zero. The same section expressly permits a tax on title insurance, and Texas title premiums are state-promulgated and material — a zero here does not mean a cheap closing.

mortgage_tax.citation: No imposing statute; Tex. Loc. Gov't Code ch. 118
mortgage_tax.caveat: Proven by absence of an imposing statute rather than by an affirmative constitutional bar, which is a weaker form of proof than Arizona's. Recording is a flat per-page schedule.

closing_costs.note: Transfer tax is computed on the purchase price. A mortgage or recording tax is computed on the LOAN AMOUNT, and is reported as not asserted when no loan is stated — never inferred from the price, which would assume 100% leverage. Rates are verified against a primary authority and carry the citation and the date confirmed; a state absent from the table reports as not asserted rather than as zero.

summary.msa.note: Metro assigned from the city/state pair.

summary.listing_brokerage.note: Generic label; no firm or individual is named in a published file.

summary.unit_count.note: Distinct unit identifiers on the roll.

summary.pricing_guidance.note: Illustrative figure supplied directly; not a quote or an offer.

summary.in_place_rent_avg.note: Occupied units, straight off the roll.

summary.market_rent_for_model.note: New-lease average where a plan has new leases in the window, else in-place. Never a blend.

t12.month_labels.note: Twelve consecutive month-end columns; direction detected from the labels.

rent_roll.units.note: Unit identifiers only; the source's resident-name column is never read.

comps.rows.note: Own weekly scrape; asking and net effective stated separately.

closing_costs.transfer_tax.amount.note: Rate applied to price_per_unit x unit_count. Per-unit statutes round the consideration up.

closing_costs.mortgage_tax.amount.note: Computed on the LOAN, never on the price. With no loan amount the line is reported as not asserted rather than inferred at 100% leverage.
